title: Who does what, end to end
sub: Film 2 of 3 of Governance on the map, the second series on data governance: one request followed from start to finish, each step done by a role, each role filled by a person or an agent with its rights written down, and the glossary run as a product.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms, and in Madrid, Lima and Mexico City between 1892 and 1956. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions; dashed cyan is the agent, which is software, never a face; green is what runs in the work, and grey what can go.
